cases.text: so tired of everything. some nights i honestly hope i just dont wake up in the morning. im not going to do anything, its just how it is lately. still have to pay the electric bill before friday and call my mom back

Every day on the way home I go over the river bridge and I keep thinking how easy it would be to pull over and climb the railing. It used to be once in a while, now it's every single drive. Anyway. Car needs to be inspected before the 15th and I have to find the registration papers.

gave my guitar to my cousin today and my good jacket to jake. wrote letters for mom and dad and my sister, they're in the top drawer. after friday none of this is going to matter anyway. just need to return the library books first so nobody gets stuck with the fine

relapsed on sh last night. 47 days clean and now im back at zero. wearing a hoodie so my mom doesnt see.
bio quiz tmrw and i havent studied AT ALL
also english essay due thursday
ugh

ok list. laundry (2 loads, the towels smell), dishes, take the recycling out, the dog is almost out of food so pet store, call the pharmacy about the refill, answer the HOA email about the fence, vacuum the stairs. honestly sometimes i think everyone would be better off without me around and i keep coming back to that more than i want to admit. also need to schedule the oil change and pick up stamps. and clean out the fridge before it gets worse

i cant do this anymore. i just want to dissapear for good. ive been saving up my pills for a while now and i know theres enough. nobody would even notice im gone tbh. work tmrw at 8 and i didnt finish the inventory sheet

I am very tired from life. Many time I think to finish my life, my mother have the strong medicine in her cabinet and I think about this. I am alone in this city, no friend. Tomorrow I must go to bank for send money to family and also I must renew my visa paper.

Since Harold passed in March I don't really see the point of going on. I've been thinking I would rather just be with him, and I've stopped taking my heart pills some days on purpose. The gutters need cleaning before the rain and I have the eye doctor Tuesday at 10. Should call Linda about the church potluck.

the kids would honestly be fine without me, maybe better. ive been looking up whether the life insurance still pays out if its not an accident. dont know why im writing this here. need to sign emmas permission slip, pack lunches, and get noah to soccer by 5

Q3 deck due Thursday, still need the revenue slide. Need to rebook the client call with Hartley since I missed it. Been spending lunch on the top level of the parking garage looking over the edge, thinking nobody would even notice until Monday. Send timesheet to Dana.

Hurting myself again. The long sleeves are back even though it's like 90 degrees out and people keep asking. I don't even know why I do it, it just makes the noise stop for a minute. Have to pick up my prescription and call the landlord about the AC.

Havent left bed in 4 days. Stopped eating mostly. I keep writing goodbye texts in my notes app and deleting them, like 6 of them now. Im so tired of being alive. Should probably answer my boss's email
i called my professor mom in office hours today. out loud. in front of two other people. i could die of embarrassment. still need to email her about the lab report extension though

This commute is killing me. 90 minutes each way and I'm so tired by the time I get home I just eat cereal and sleep. Need to look into the monthly train pass and ask my manager about working from home on Fridays.
my basil plant finally died lol. rip. i tried. anyway today: buy potting soil, water the other plants, clean the bathroom, take out trash

Slept like the dead, 11 hours, and still groggy somehow.
Today:
- dentist at 2
- groceries
- text Sam back about Saturday
DEAD TIRED. double shift again tomorrow. have to iron my uniform and set like 3 alarms
if i have to sit through one more group project meeting where nobody did their part im going to jump out a window lmao. so annoyed. need to finish my 3 slides and send them to priya tonight
Absolutely killed it at the presentation today, my boss even said so. Now I have to submit the expense report and the conference abstract is due Friday.
Cutting it close with rent again, paycheck doesn't hit until Thursday and I'm anxious about it. Need to call the landlord, cancel the gym membership I never use, and check if the phone bill autopaid.

everything feels kind of gray. i feel numb mostly, not sad exactly. havent done laundry in two weeks. need to do laundry, write back to grandma's card, and make a doctor appointment about my meds because i think the dose is off

Finals week and I am drowning. Chem final Monday, I haven't even started the review packet. Calc problem set due Tuesday. History paper needs a works cited page. I also told Jordan I'd help him move on Sunday which was a terrible idea. I feel so behind on everything and I can't focus for more than 10 minutes.

I've been ignoring Maya's texts for a week and I feel awful about it, guilty every time I see her name. She didn't do anything wrong. I just feel so alone lately and don't know what to say. Need to text her back today, even just a short one.

work stuff

1. finish the onboarding doc for the new hire
2. reply to the vendor about the late shipment
3. book the room for the quarterly review

i feel like i'm underwater, every time i finish one thing two more show up
need to renew my passport
SO angry at my roommate. third time this week she left her dishes in the sink for days. I need to talk to her tonight and also buy more dish soap since apparently I'm the only one who does

brain is everywhere today. dying to just finish one thing. need to: return the amazon package, refill the cat's meds, renew car insurance, reply to the wedding rsvp, buy a birthday gift for dad, oh and the water filter. keep starting one and jumping to another
Small win: finally called the insurance company yesterday and paid the water bill. Still need to schedule the car service and pick up dry cleaning.

Nothing ever changes. Same job, same desk, three years. I feel stuck and honestly kind of hopeless that it'll ever get better here. I should update my resume this weekend and look at the openings Chris sent me.
Missed my therapy appointment because I slept through the alarm, really disappointed in myself. Have to call the office Monday to reschedule and ask about the no-show fee.
